STAGE S · THE SCALPER RETUNED ["scalp"]: trade the 5m 12/89 cross TOWARD the far 1h boundary.
 Preconditions: R2 must PASS at 1h (the 1h range is the target; if 1h ranges are not respected net of
    toll, the mode is closed and the stage prints that verdict and stops).

    1h boundary breach; no trail (this is a range trade — target or stop); 4h tide NOT required (range
    trades are two-way inside balance).
 Twins on every row: taker toll (record) AND maker toll (limit fill at the 5m close, entry and target
    only) — the reopening path. Regime gate printed: 5m ATR tercile, 1h boundary age.
